landing.heroTitle: International Association for the Defense of Flowers
landing.heroTagline: Where humanity blooms, nature is reborn.
landing.description: A literary saga and transmedia ecosystem that unites 195 national flowers and their pollinators through innovative formats: an illustrated book, an engaging card game, a comprehensive 3D floral archive, and interactive robotic exhibitions.
landing.bookTitle: Nahiara & the Guardians of the Flowers
landing.bookDesc: An illustrated literary journey through the world's most beautiful flowers
landing.gameDesc: Interactive gameplay celebrating global floral diversity
landing.archiveDesc: National flowers in high-quality glTF/STL formats
landing.exhibitionDesc: Museographic experiences bringing flowers to life
landing.visionText: Connecting cultures through the universal language of flowers, raising awareness about biodiversity, and fostering institutional and editorial collaborations worldwide.
landing.storyText: Nahiara & the Guardians of the Flowers is more than just a book—it's a gateway to a magical world where every national flower tells a story. Through this interactive digital experience, you can explore the 195 flowers that inspired the tale and discover the real-world connections between cultures, nature, and conservation.
landing.journeyText: The book is just the beginning. Explore the complete digital ecosystem of Nahiara's world.
landing.archiveDesc2: Explore all 195 national flowers in stunning 3D detail. Click on any flower to learn about its cultural significance, conservation status, and role in Nahiara's story.
landing.sagaDesc: Discover the full literary universe including the illustrated card game, robotic exhibitions, and educational resources that bring Nahiara's world to life.
landing.communityText: You're now part of a growing community of readers, educators, and conservationists who believe in the power of storytelling to connect cultures and protect biodiversity. Share your experience, connect with other flower guardians, and help us spread Nahiara's message around the world.
landing.shareText: Help us spread Nahiara's message! Share your thoughts about the book, tag us in your posts, and connect with other readers around the world.

landing.aboutTitle: International Association for the Defense of Flowers
landing.aboutBody1: We are an international association based in the Canary Islands, created to defend the planet's floral biodiversity through education, culture, and community action.
landing.aboutBody2: We work across seven areas: literature, educational play, digital platform, botanical archive, community workshops, institutional programs, and international outreach.
landing.aboutBody3: Every project we lead is born from one conviction: flowers guard the memory of the world, and protecting them means protecting what makes us human.
landing.project1Title: Nahiara and the Guardians of the Flowers
landing.project1Description: An ecofiction saga that journeys through the national flowers of 195 countries. Volume I is already available in Spanish.
landing.project2Title: Guardians of the Flowers — The Game
landing.project2Description: Cooperative trilingual game (ES/EN/DE) for all ages. 195 national flowers. Three generations at one table.
landing.project3Description: The interactive platform of the Nahiara universe: 3D botanical archive, global illustration gallery, and multilingual digital experience.
landing.project4Title: Draw the Flower of Your Country
landing.project4Description: A civic participation initiative that invites people of all ages to draw the national flower of their country of origin or adoption.
landing.project5Title: Guardians of the Flowers in the Classroom
landing.project5Description: Workshop program for schools, libraries, and civic centers. Biodiversity, cultural identity, and environmental values through play and storytelling.

alliances.title: Academic and Institutional Alliances
alliances.body1: The International Association for the Defense of Flowers has reached a collaboration agreement with Lovely Professional University (Punjab, India), welcoming Aditya Singh as an intern during May and June 2026.
alliances.body2: This alliance reinforces our commitment to international educational cooperation and knowledge exchange between institutions with a global vision.
alliances.body3: We warmly thank LPU for its support and for the institutional recognition extended to the work of our Association.
alliances.futureBody: This section is designed to grow with new academic and institutional collaborations as the project expands internationally.
